title: Marryandbride header
description: A boutique header laid over the first screen: two tracked uppercase links at the left, a serif wordmark in the centre, two links and a heart and bag icon with tiny counts at the right (a menu icon on phones). It is transparent with light text over the hero, slides up out of view when you scroll down and slides back, now solid paper, when you scroll up.
notes: it takes no space of its own (negative bottom margin): place it right before a full-bleed hero
over the hero it uses text-background, so the hero should be dark (in light mode) behind it
the hide/show on scroll and the phone menu need JavaScript; static HTML shows it in place
